learning_outcomes.text: Classify the characterization methods applied to materials and understand their necessity.
Understands which analysis and method will be used to determine the desired feature.
Classify the methods used in microstructure analysis and understand their data.
Classifies phase analysis methods, understands the principles of analysis, follows them and improves herself
Classifies thermal analysis methods, understands and evaluates their data, and creates awareness

syllabus_topics: Material Production Methods (vacuum techniques, MBE-sputtering-thermal evaporation, atomic layer deposition, laser ablation)
Material Production Methods-(non-vacuum techniques, electrochemical techniques
Types of Materials and the Interaction of Electromagnetic Waves with Matter
Structural Characterization - Microscopy Techniques (Electron microscopes: TEM, SEM, STEM, scanning electron microscope (SEM), transmission electron microscope (TEM)
Structural Characterization - Microscopy Techniques (atomic force microscope AFM, Magnetic force microscope-MFM)
Structural Characterization - Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy (FTIR), Raman spectroscopy
Elemental Analysis-Energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX), Wavelength dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (WDX), X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS)
Optical Characterization- Optical Microscope, UV-vis spectrometer
Mechanical Characterization - measurement of viscosity, elastic-plastic properties, determination of tensile-rupture-yield points
Thermal Characterization-differential thermal analysis, thermogravimetric analysis
Electrical and Electronic Characterization-Conductivity measurement, Hall effect measurement, C-V; I-V measurements
Magnetic Characterization–Measurement of magnetic properties (VSM, MOKE, etc.)
